- Path: /data/tasks/make-managed-task-wo_yflmo5lg/c1-git-metadata
- Exact head: a51cf1a569d6de8ce35e035eab5100b74be02d47
- Branch: fix/task-git-metadata-projection-c1
- C1 diff base used: local main at 3d042e9d8. Note: this clone has no origin/main ref; upstream/main exists but is one commit ahead of local main. The C1 diff is exactly two files.
- Canonical PR: #3496 per Coordinator handoff. `gh pr view 3496 --repo kdlbs/kandev ...` could not be refreshed because GraphQL rate limit is already exceeded for user ID 79718216.

Reviewed files:
- apps/backend/internal/worktree/git_metadata.go
- apps/backend/internal/worktree/git_metadata_test.go

Validation run:
- cd /data/tasks/make-managed-task-wo_yflmo5lg/c1-git-metadata/apps/backend && go test ./internal/worktree => PASS (31.369s)
- git diff --check main...HEAD -- apps/backend/internal/worktree/git_metadata.go apps/backend/internal/worktree/git_metadata_test.go => PASS
- disposable proof test outside reviewed checkout: copied apps/backend to /tmp, added a temporary test asserting ResolveGitMetadata rejects a `.git` pointer whose target traverses a symlink to the real linked-worktree gitdir. That test FAILS because ResolveGitMetadata returns nil error. Original C1 checkout remained clean at a51cf1a.

BLOCKING FINDING:
1. Symlinked gitdir pointer path is accepted after canonicalization erases the symlink evidence — apps/backend/internal/worktree/git_metadata.go:306
   Failure scenario: create a legitimate linked worktree, replace its regular `.git` file with `gitdir: /tmp/gitdir-link` where `/tmp/gitdir-link` is a symlink to the real per-worktree gitdir. The reciprocal `gitdir` file still points back to the checkout `.git`, so ResolveGitMetadata accepts the projection. I verified this in a disposable copy: a temporary regression expecting ErrGitMetadataProjectionInvalid failed with `ResolveGitMetadata error = <nil>`.
   Why it matters: the approved threat model explicitly requires rejecting symlink swaps during final revalidation, and `.git` pointer contents are evidence to validate, not authority. The current code calls canonicalExistingPath from readGitdirPointer (lines 306-322) and then rejectSymlinkComponents on the already-resolved canonical target (lines 202-208), so an intermediate symlink in the pointer path is invisible by the time validation runs. The same pattern should also be audited for metadata pointer values read by readMetadataPathStrict (lines 325-344), especially `commondir`, because those values are likewise canonicalized before symlink-component rejection.
   Suggested fix: validate the raw absolute pointer path for symlink components before EvalSymlinks/canonicalization, then canonicalize and continue reciprocal/common-dir validation. Add regression tests for a symlinked `.git` pointer target and, if the same helper is changed, a symlinked `commondir` value. Keep the existing canonical equality checks after that raw-path rejection.

No source edits made. No self-move. Umbrella checkout/PR3242/head 9baf6bfa4d50d61a54139e9439d66130e45d3b24 untouched.
